title: Mail Simulator
instructions:
Help Grandpa Jürgen inspect his 15 emails. Check the actual sender, message, link destinations and attachment names.

  • Suspicious emails: Trash.
  • Genuine emails requiring action: Marked.
  • Genuine emails requiring no action: Archive.

Hover or focus links to see their destination below. Check your sorting when finished. You can move messages back to the inbox. All messages, links and attachments are simulated.
practiceInstructions: Compose, reply and forward here. Sending only stores a message in the local Sent folder. No real email is sent.
subject: Subject
tryAgain: Some messages are misplaced. Review them again.
simulation: Simulation – no real email, downloads or websites.
linkSimulated: Simulated link. Its destination appears below; no website opens.
attachmentSimulated: Simulated attachment. No file is opened or downloaded.
invalidRecipient: Enter valid email addresses separated by commas or semicolons.
sentLocally: Message saved locally in the simulator.
